nodes.label: The hard gate (analytical validation tests)
nodes.rationale: No task above the solver may be marked done while the analytical gate tests are red; if a change turns them red, the change is wrong, not the test.

nodes.label: Kelvin-everywhere / Celsius-only-at-UI convention
nodes.rationale: Kelvin used inside packages/*, Celsius only in apps/web/lib/units.ts; a stray -273.15 anywhere else is a defect even if the displayed number looks right.

nodes.label: Single sign convention (positive adds energy)
nodes.rationale: Positive adds energy to the modelled system; flipping a sign to make a chart look right is a bug, not a fix.

nodes.label: No-ANSYS-comparison-claim rule
nodes.rationale: No ANSYS comparison claim may appear anywhere in the repo until an actual ANSYS run exists with a stated deviation; AUDIT.md F-2 calls this the most dangerous sentence in the plan.

nodes.label: Ventilation safety floor (ACH_MIN = 0.35)
nodes.rationale: Non-negotiable minimum air-changes-per-hour, enforced twice (infiltration.ts and the optimiser's constraint check) as deliberate defence in depth against carbon-monoxide fatality from a sealed shelter with a stove.

nodes.label: Database is a cache/share layer, never a dependency
nodes.rationale: Every feature on the demo path must work with the database stopped; each database task carries an acceptance test proving that.

nodes.label: No accounts / auth / sessions rule
nodes.rationale: No user accounts, auth, sessions, JWT, permissions, or users table anywhere in the project.

nodes.label: Material catalogue citation rule
nodes.rationale: Every row of the material catalogue carries a non-empty source citation, enforced by schema constraint and test, per BLUEPRINT.md 7.4.

nodes.label: AI advice number-verification rule
nodes.rationale: Every number in AI-generated advice text must be findable in the simulation output; text failing the automated check is rejected and the template fallback is used instead.

nodes.label: T-80 — wire real connectivity detection into dispatchSimulation()
§3 How to mark a task done
"Bundled annual weather" not a true TMY
nodes.rationale: These files are NASA POWER reanalysis for one real calendar year (2023), not a multi-decade statistically-blended TMY; called out explicitly so the naming isn't mistaken for a real TMY construction.

nodes.label: Five bundled TMY locations (Leh, Kargil, Drass, Nubra, Jaisalmer)
plan.md — The Plan, In Plain English
Stage 1 — the search (real physics, no AI)
Stage 2 — the write-up (AI translation of results)
Automated AI-number-verification check
nodes.rationale: The AI is not allowed to invent a number; every figure in its text must be found directly in the simulation output, or the text is rejected — the physics decides, the AI only translates.

nodes.label: What we deliberately do not build (§9)
nodes.rationale: CFD, room-by-room modelling, heating-equipment models, damp/mould modelling, user accounts and a phone app were each considered and cut on purpose to avoid scope creep.

nodes.label: Proving the physics is right (§10 subsection)
Elevation lapse-rate correction (plain-English explainer)
nodes.rationale: NASA's ~55 km grid squares can be hundreds of metres off a shelter's real elevation; since air cools ~6.5 °C/km, this is corrected automatically and shown on screen rather than applied silently.

nodes.label: Branch protocol (one branch per task, T-NN commit prefix)
Zero network (T-66) — field-deployment PWA mechanism
nodes.rationale: A PWA needs one prior online visit to install its service worker, so a second, independent mechanism (static export) is needed for a true cold-start demo; sw.js/manifest exist but nothing currently registers them from layout.tsx, and store.ts's dispatchSimulation() never flips store.online.

nodes.label: Known ledger defect: app/api removal breaks ordinary build
nodes.rationale: components/inputs/inputs.test.ts imports app/api/materials/route, which Next's build-time TS pass can't resolve once app/api/ is deleted; build-static.mjs sidesteps it by never copying test files, but the ordinary build is still affected.

nodes.label: T-07 — Canonical test fixtures incl. C-01 kill-shot pair
MAT vs M key-naming deviation note
nodes.rationale: MAT uses different key names than the pre-existing M (e.g. stone not granite); M/G left untouched for pre-existing tests, downstream tasks should key off MAT for LOG.md §7.11 values.

nodes.label: T-18 — Shading: mountain horizon and window overhangs
Beam-only shading simplification
nodes.rationale: Shading is applied only to the beam solar component, not the diffuse sky dome; documented ceiling with an upgrade path (sky-dome view-factor reduction) that must reach the limitations list and EQUATIONS.md.

nodes.label: PCM refresh-cadence contract note
nodes.rationale: Wiring a PCM node into the solver must not refactorise the matrix more often; either add Picard iteration or lag the apparent capacitance and emit a meta.warnings entry when lagged, per the T-11 refresh-cadence contract.

nodes.label: T-21 — Couple infiltration to opening area (closes AUDIT F-6)
envelopeAreaM2 double-counted glazing (root cause of concave coupling)
nodes.rationale: index.ts's envelopeAreaM2 added glazingAreaM2 on top of an already-gross exterior-surface-area sum, making the ACH/solar coupling concave and algebraically incapable of an interior minimum (K-05); fixed by summing exterior surface areas once, making the coupling linear.

nodes.label: Sunrise/sunset zenith-90° vs NOAA's 90.833° gap
nodes.rationale: sunriseSunset()/halfDayHours() use a geometric horizon (zenith 90°) while NOAA's tabulated values use 90.833° (refraction + solar-disk radius), a structural ~4-6.5 min gap at Leh's latitude no numerical precision fix can close.

nodes.label: declination() equinox timing offset (Cooper 1969)
nodes.rationale: The single-harmonic Cooper 1969 declination model's equinox lands ~1.4 days after the true equinox, costing 0.67-0.87° of peak-altitude accuracy near 21 Mar/Sep; solstices remain accurate to 0.01-0.02°.

nodes.label: T-24 — Material, glazing and construction catalogues
Local type redefinition vs importing @shelter/engine types
nodes.rationale: Material/Glazing/Layer/EngineError are redefined locally in packages/data rather than imported, keeping packages/data's runtime dependency on the engine at zero while relying on TypeScript's structural typing for compatibility.

nodes.label: T-28 — Presets: the app opens on an interesting result
optimisedPassivePlaceholder is a hand-authored stand-in, not a sweep result
nodes.rationale: Per AUDIT.md C-16 (never present a hand-authored preset as 'optimised'), preset 5 is flagged with an approximations entry and must be replaced by T-56's real sweep winner once the optimiser ships.

nodes.label: Surface.area doc/code discrepancy (NET vs GROSS)
nodes.rationale: CONTRACTS.md 7.5 says Surface.area is NET, but solve/assemble.ts and every passing fixture treat it as GROSS (window area subtracted from it); the working code was followed and the doc flagged as needing correction.

nodes.label: HDKR sky-model Rb unclamped divergence bug
nodes.rationale: transposition.ts's HDKR branch computes Rb = cosTheta / cosZenith with a lower floor but no upper clamp; near sunrise at Leh's January latitude Rb reaches several hundred, causing SOLVER_DIVERGED on every Ladakh preset — worked around with skyModel: 'isotropic', needs a real fix (Rb clamp or altitude gating) in Area B.
